title: Scalar compatibility of the specified intrinsic inverse-image clopen word
statement: For any inverse ring system C with transitions τ and any compatible ring maps B→C_n, let rho be the existing section-normalized exact scalar restriction of [def-sf-semilinear-scalar-normalization-data]. For any commutative proper/open square k:V→W, r:V→S, p:W→T, i:S→T with k,i quasi-compact open and r,p proper, and every M in D(S), the exact inverse-image word alpha satisfies rho_W(alpha_Q(M)); rhoJ_k(P_r M); J_k^B(rhoP_r(M)) = rhoP_p(J_i M); G_p^B(rhoJ_i(M)); alpha_Q^B(rho_S M). Here semicolons mean composition in written order, and every comparison is the specified rhoP or rhoJ, not an independently chosen coefficient isomorphism. This asserts compatibility of the exact beta/projector/compositor word only; it does not involve derived direct image or the proper mate gamma.

source.place: Tag 0F7B, open case, and sites-modules.tex Tags 03D7 and 03DI. Agent-formulated exact coefficient comparison for the intrinsic clopen word, the inverse-image step of the item proof, not a verbatim assertion of these tags.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-semilinear-scalar-ordinary-comparison] to obtain a normalized ordinary package D. Its level identifications and transition equations give a section-normalized natural isomorphism a_X:D.rho X≅rhoOrdinary X for each scheme X. Use the already proved restriction_rho_iso construction from the support module, with the restriction record obtained by projecting D.

Compare the conjugated D.d with the chosen ordinary direct-image isomorphism on every section: both maps are the identity. Sectionwise extensionality identifies them. Apply the inverse mate bijection, then exact localization, to identify rhoP with scalarB D conjugated by the localized a_X. Apply the inverse open mate bijection to identify rhoJ with scalarA D under the same conjugation. The open units determine this comparison uniquely; no faithfulness on derived morphisms is needed.

Use the alpha preservation clause of [lem-sf-semilinear-scalar-derived-comparison]. The pre-mate alpha normalization proved in [lem-sf-intrinsic-varying-ring-mate-normalization] identifies the intrinsic and varying-ring beta/projector/compositor words. Substitute the conjugation formulas for scalarB and scalarA. Naturality of a_W for alpha and of strict alpha for a_S moves the boundary identifications to the outside, where adjacent inverse pairs cancel. This yields exactly the asserted equation for the specified rho, rhoP and rhoJ.

lean.statement:
theorem intrinsicScalarAlphaCompatibility
    {V W S T : Scheme.{u}} (k : V ⟶ W) (r : V ⟶ S) (p : W ⟶ T) (i : S ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i]
    [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (M : Derived C τ S) :
    (rho C τ B φ hφ W).map ((alpha C τ k r p i h).app M) ≫
        (rhoJ C τ B φ hφ k).hom.app ((P C τ r).obj M) ≫
        (StrictTower.J B k).map ((rhoP C τ B φ hφ r).hom.app M) =
      (rhoP C τ B φ hφ p).hom.app ((J C τ i).obj M) ≫
        (StrictTower.G B p).map ((rhoJ C τ B φ hφ i).hom.app M) ≫
        (StrictTower.alpha B k r p i h).app ((rho C τ B φ hφ S).obj M)
